Resolutions of 1986

13 resolutions, 77% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 581 (1986) South Africa's threats against States in southern Africa
  • 582 (1986) Calling for cease-fire and exchange of prisoners between Iraq and the Islamic Republic of Iran
  • 583 (1986) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 584 (1986) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 585 (1986) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
  • 586 (1986) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 587 (1986) Security of the personnel of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 588 (1986) Implementation of resolution 582 (1986) on the armed conflict between Iraq and the Islamic Republic of Iran
  • 589 (1986) Appointment of Javier Pérez de Cuéllar as Secretary-General of the United Nations
  • 590 (1986) Extension of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 591 (1986) The arms embargo against South Africa
  • 592 (1986) Israeli policy towards Palestinians in the occupied territories
  • 593 (1986) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
